belegdatum.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null if no document issue date is printed. Do not substitute delivery date.

gesamtbetrag.description: Final gross document amount as decimal string with two decimal places. Preserve the printed negative sign for credit notes; do not substitute line totals or subtotals.

ust_idnr.description: Issuer VAT identifier exactly as printed, even if synthetically invalid. Null when absent.

dokumentart.description: Canonical German category: Rechnung or Gutschrift.
